summary: Former tower site in Logan County, WV (US 1637, WV 28); observer injured in an October 1953 generator explosion and fire; listed as gone, no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Listed as a former tower site; the sources we read do not say when it came down.

events.note: Tower in place with only a forest telephone connection; a line from the Blair station to the Madison central office was planned
Cody Allen was the tower observer in District 5
A generator exploded and a fire broke out at the tower; the observer was hurt and the observation room windows were shattered

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The two October 1953 newspaper items disagree: one says electric, the other gasoline. The story reports the disagreement and does not pick one.
The state number WV 28 is also listed for Sleepy Creek on the state list; the register number US 1637 identifies this site.

sources.title: Spring Mountain Tower Site
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites Register, Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: No build year and no removal date appear in any source read. The 1926 item is the earliest found. The Forest Lookouts page carries a bare Removed heading with no date. Access is unknown; the brief's access field is not set. Two WebSearch queries were run; nothing new beyond the register and the Forest Lookouts page. The register and state list both show WV 28 for Sleepy Creek, so the WV number alone does not identify a site.
